                3'b100: light <= 3'b001; // Transition to red
                default: light <= 3'b001;
            endcase
        end
    end
endmodule

    end

module sequence_detector(
     input  clk, 
     input  rst_n,
     input  data_in, 
     output sequence_detected				
     );
    reg [2:0] state;
    reg sequence_detected;

    always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
        if (!rst_n) begin
            state <= 3'b000;
            sequence_detected <= 0;
        end
        else begin
            case (state)
                3'b000: begin
                    if (data_in) begin
                        state <= 3'b001;
                    end
                end
                3'b001: begin
                    if (data_in) begin
                        state <= 3'b010;
                    end
                end
                3'b010: begin
                    if (data_in) begin
                        state <= 3'b100;
                    end
                end
                3'b100: begin
                    if (data_in) begin
                        state <= 3'b101;
                        sequence_detected <= 1;
                    end
                end
                default: begin
                    state <= 3'b000;
                end
            endcase
        end
    end
endmodule
